# MeteorBase API & Telemetry Gateway

> MeteorBase is a high-performance ASGI telemetry gateway and Python PyPI SDK built with FastAPI, Google Cloud Firestore, and Gemini AI. It provides real-time system monitoring, automated 90-day data retention cleanup, and intelligent request summarization with sub-40ms regional latency.

## Core Endpoints
- `/healthz`: Instant liveness probe reporting node status and in-memory retention telemetry.
- `/readyz`: Readines probe verifying ASGI gateway and database availability.
- `/ping`: Service acknowledgment endpoint with non-blocking 90-day retention evaluation.
- `/api/test`: Ultra-low latency static connectivity probe.
- `/summarize`: AI summarization engine powered by Google Gemini for request logs and telemetry payloads.
- `/api/telemetry/stats`: Compressed 24-hour rolling activity stream with latency histograms and 90-day uptime records.
- `/public-docs`: Interactive OpenAPI 3.1 specification for public SDK developers.

## PyPI SDK Integration
```python
from meteorbase import MeteorBaseClient

client = MeteorBaseClient(api_key="your_api_key", base_url="https://meteorbaseapi.vercel.app")
status = client.health_check()
print(status)
```

## Performance & Architecture
- Edge Deployment: Hosted on Vercel's Mumbai (`bom1`) node for sub-50ms latency.
- Non-blocking I/O: Background tasks execute database maintenance without delaying HTTP responses.
- Security: Zero-trust bearer token authentication and strict Firestore security rules.
- Optional Full LLM Reference: https://meteorbaseapi.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
